english.note: Use this noun phrase for a person or thing that has just arrived, especially when identifying a new arrival.

examples.english: The new arrival has already taken a seat.
examples.traditional: 啱啱到嘅新同事已經坐低喇。
examples.jyutping: ngaam1 ngaam1 dou3 ge3 san1 tung4 si6 ji5 ging1 co5 dai1 laa3
